title: Processes: Canopy, litter and ponded water
intro: Rain and irrigation are intercepted by the canopy and the litter layer and evaporate from them; what passes goes to the surface pond. The pond infiltrates into the matrix, the biopores (tertiary infiltration) or runs off. Tillage resets the surface.
